blinding_guess.why: B ships a test suite and stricter validation, which may come from a spec-driven process, but both are similar in structure and money handling.

notes: Both store integer cents, split remainders deterministically, and use a greedy largest-debtor/largest-creditor settlement; core probes pass on both. A adds list/remove commands and removes duplicate participants; B rejects duplicates and splits comma-separated names. Bandit reports are empty for both. The stdlib probe used a hard-coded fallback module set because the host runs Python 3.9 (no sys.stdlib_module_names); both import only argparse/json/os/sys/tempfile/decimal (+heapq in A). B's LOC excludes its 148-line test file.
